config.language.auto: Follow the IDE display language (Chinese → 中文, otherwise English)
config.language.desc: Language used by CodeLadder explanations and the panel. `auto` follows the IDE display language.
config.llm.baseUrl.desc: OpenAI-compatible API base URL, domain level only — e.g. `https://api.deepseek.com`. CodeLadder appends `/chat/completions` itself, so do not include the endpoint path. A model exposed by the IDE (`vscode.lm`) is preferred; when none is available this endpoint is required, because the business context and the L1/L2 tiers are generated only by a model. Set `baseUrl`, `apiKey` and `model` together.
config.llm.apiKey.desc: API key for the model endpoint (stored in plain text; recommended for personal devices only).
config.llm.maxInputChars.desc: Maximum characters of code sent per request (default 24000). Only changed units are sent; when the budget is exceeded the remaining units are left for the next run.
config.autoRefresh.enabled.desc: Re-analyze the file shown in the panel automatically after it is saved. Off by default. Only changed groups are sent to the model.
config.autoRefresh.globs.desc: Glob patterns of files that auto-refresh applies to, relative to the workspace folder — e.g. `src/**/*.py`. Leave empty to apply to every supported file.
